Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Rajesh Kumar
---------

For the Petitioner : Mr. Gautam Kr. Pandey, Advocate
 For the State : Mr. Tarun Kumar, A.P.P
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned counsel for the State.

2. The applicant-husband, who is in custody since 17.08.2023, has approached this Court for grant of regular bail in connection with S.T. No.431(A) of 2014, arising out of Keredari P.S. Case No.92 of 2013, registered for the offence under Sections 498A/ 304B/ 201/ 34 of the Indian Penal Code.

3. It appears that this applicant has been roped in the present case using Section 319 of the Cr.P.C.
4.

It has been submitted by the learned counsel for the applicant that complete set of F.I.R along with its enclosures have been annexed with the present bail application and there is no suppression on his part.
Innocence of the applicant has been claimed and undertaking has been given for participation in the trial.
It has been submitted that in the original trial all the accused persons have been acquitted by the court below itself.
There is no material against this applicant.
On the above basis, prayer for bail has been made.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the State has opposed the prayer for bail.
6. Considering the above facts, I am inclined to enlarge the applicant on bail.

Accordingly, the applicant is directed to be released on bail, on his furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- (Ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Additional Sessions Judge - II, Hazaribag in connection with S.T. No.431(A) of 2014, arising out of Keredari P.S. Case No.92 of 2013, on the condition that the applicant will submit self-attested photocopy of his Aadhaar Card and his mobile number before the learned court below which he will always keep active and will not change it during pendency of this case without prior permission of the court.

(Rajesh Kumar, J.) Chandan/-
